core_obligations: Show i^* f_* alpha' = g_* (i')^* alpha' in Z_k(D) under L|_D ~ O_D (proof lines 2587-2603). The statement makes sense as all operations are defined on cycles, see chow-remark-gysin-on-cycles (tag 0B6Z) (proof lines 2588-2590). By additivity reduce to alpha' = [W'] for an integral closed subscheme W' of X' with image W = f(W') in X (proof line 2591). Case W' not subset D': then W not subset D and [W' cap D']_k = div_{L'|_{W'}}(s'|_{W'}) and [W cap D]_k = div_{L|_W}(s|_W); f_* of the first equals the second by chow-lemma-equal-c1-as-cycles (tag 02ST), so the equality holds as cycles (proof lines 2592-2601). Case W' subset D': then W subset D and both sides are zero by construction (proof lines 2601-2602).
proof_roadmap: Legitimize the statement on the cycle level via the Gysin-on-cycles remark (proof lines 2588-2590).
Reduce to integral closed subschemes and split into the two containment cases (proof line 2591).
Non-contained case: divisor computations identified by the equal-c1 lemma under proper pushforward; contained case: both sides zero (proof lines 2592-2602).
